display.purpose: The wordmark on Get Started only (Papaya in Deep Papaya, HatidGo in Papaya Leaf).

title.purpose: Button labels, role card names; typed field text at 400.

body.purpose: Notices, hints, notes. Tabular numerals app-wide.

lead.purpose: One calm soft-ink line under a heading.

label.purpose: Field labels, step counters, field errors.

contrast.use: logo artwork only; never text or behind text

focus.name: focus-ring

motion.name: ease-settle

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action on the screen. Exactly one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #c2410c; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9a3412; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c1714; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The second way forward, same size, quieter.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #c2410c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c2410c; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: #fff1e6; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c1714; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Underlined link action that stays a 56px touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #c2410c; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c1714; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Persistent label, optional hint, 60px input, one marked error line.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1714; } .ds-field__input { min-height: 60px; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; border: 2px solid #8a7f77; border-radius: 16px; background: #f7f3ee; color: #1c1714; font: inherit; font-size: 20px; caret-color: #c2410c; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #5a4f47; opacity: 1; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c2410c; } .ds-field__error { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #b42318; }

components.name: Role Card
components.description: Two-way choice card; selected = 3px orange border, tint, and a green check mark.
components.css: .ds-role { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; } .ds-role__card { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 104px; padding: 16px 8px; border: 2px solid #8a7f77; border-radius: 16px; background: #f7f3ee; color: #1c1714; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-role__card--on { border: 3px solid #c2410c; background: #fff1e6; } .ds-role__card--on svg:not(.ds-role__check) { color: #c2410c; } .ds-role__check { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; } .ds-role__card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c1714; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Alert Notice
components.description: Form-level error, always led by an icon.
components.html: Mali ang email o password.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-notice svg { flex: none; } .ds-notice--alert { background: #fef0ee; color: #b42318; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #b42318; }

components.name: OK Notice
components.description: Success or info message with a green mark.
components.html: Napalitan na ang password mo.
components.css: .ds-notice-ok { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: #e8f5e9; color: #1c1714; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2e7d32; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-notice-ok svg { flex: none; }

components.description: White form-screen toolbar with only a 52px ink back button; the heading lives in the page.

components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1714; } .ds-toolbar__back { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 52px; min-height: 52px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #1c1714; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar__back:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c1714; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A calm, bright, white ride app that an older tricycle driver can read outdoors, one-handed, on a low-end Android phone. The look is the user's own mockup, pinned as canon: clean white screens, deep papaya orange for the one next action, papaya-leaf green for the brand and for success, and the tricycle + papaya-leaf logo. Everything else is white space and big near-black text.

Density is low on purpose. One family (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, built for low-vision readers) sits on an 18px root, so the smallest text is 18px and nothing is ever below 16px. Controls are full-width, soft-cornered and tall (56px minimum, 60px for buttons and fields). Labels stay above their fields, examples are written in Taglish as "hal. ...", and every state carries a mark as well as a color.

The app is always white. There is no dark scheme: the status bar always uses dark icons (Capacitor StatusBar Style.Light), and a phone in dark theme still shows the white app. A night mode may return later only as an explicit in-app user setting, never by following the system.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, warm off-white fields, near-black warm ink.
One orange primary action per screen; green only for brand and success.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400/700/800, 18px root, never below 16px.
Tall, full-width, 16px-radius controls; flat, no shadows.
States shown by mark plus color; Taglish copy with "hal." examples.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Each screen has exactly one filled orange button: the next action. Every other way forward is an outline or text button.

rules.name: The Bright Papaya Stays in the Logo Rule
rules.body: #f57c00 appears only inside the logo artwork. Any orange behind or as text is #c2410c.

rules.name: The Always White Rule
rules.body: The app does not follow the system dark theme. Status bar icons are always dark.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text anywhere is below 16px. The 18px root makes 1rem the working minimum.

rules.name: The Labels Stay Rule
rules.body: Every field has a visible label above it; placeholders are only Taglish examples ("hal. 0917 123 4567", "hal. juan@gmail.com", "hal. 0917 123 4567 o email"), never the label.

rules.name: The Flat Sun Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A boundary is a 2px line (3px on a selected card), never a shadow.

dos: Do give every screen exactly one Deep Papaya (#c2410c) filled button for the next action; later screens (booking map, active ride, driver home) follow this too.
Do make every control at least 56px tall and every button and field 60px.
Do keep all text at 16px or larger (1rem = 18px root).
Do put a visible label above every field and use placeholders only for Taglish "hal." examples.
Do show every state by a mark plus color: error icon plus red, check mark plus orange border, success icon plus green border.
Do write copy in plain Taglish.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: transitions and the logo rise turn off.
Do keep the app white and the status bar icons dark, whatever the phone theme.
donts: Don't use Bright Papaya (#f57c00) for text or behind text (2.7:1 with white).
Don't signal a state with color alone.
Don't use Hairline (#d8cfc6) as a control border; controls use Field Line (#8a7f77).
Don't add drop shadows; boundaries are 2px lines.
Don't follow the system dark theme; a night mode may come back only as an explicit user setting.
Don't set inputmode="email" on a field that also accepts a mobile number.
